status: proposed: thresholds to be signed off with O&M before any rule uses them

notes.irradiance_min_wm2: below this the translation error of the modelled curve grows; points are drawn but not diagnostic
notes.stale_s: a live record older than this is stale (hollow), never shown as now
notes.weather_max_gap_s: the sensor record and the inverter record must be within this of each other (one record interval; both report about every 5 min)
notes.clip_pct_of_rated: AC at or above this share of rated power x the power limit = clipped or limited, the point is off MPP
notes.off_mpp_voltage_ratio: V above this x Vmp(model) = the MPPT walked towards Voc (zero export / curtailment)
notes.sanity_current_max: I above this x Isc(model) = reading or model out of range
notes.sanity_voltage_max: V above this x Voc(model) = reading or model out of range
